Author: Wormzey
Name: [TPlog] Reward Reset Timer
Punchline: Shows when daily and weekly duty rewards refresh, right next to "Reward already received" in the Duty Finder.
Description: Adds a countdown beside the Duty Finder's "Reward already received" text: the daily reset (15:00 UTC) for roulettes, and the weekly reset (Tuesday 08:00 UTC) for other duties. /rewardreset opens settings and prints both timers to chat.
